{{Quote|The larger ships, the Firekilns, are more powerful than you realize. Laser to laser, five of them are an even match for his Star Destroyer, and Nuso Esva currently has eight of them in place.|Warlord Nuso Esva, under the pseudonym of Lord Odo|<ref name="Choices" />}}
A '''Firekiln''' was a type of [[Warship/Legends|warship]] deployed by the [[Nuso Esva's battle fleet|battle fleet]] of [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s [[Nuso Esva's realm|realm]]. Heavily [[Weapon/Legends|armed]], five Firekilns were as powerful as a single [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], one of Esva's [[Nuso Esva's attack squadron|attack squadrons]] that included eight Firekilns [[Engagement at Teptixii|engaged]] and attempted to capture part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Task Force Admonitor|Task Force ''Admonitor'']]&mdash;whose [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] was the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]''&mdash;in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Teptixii system/Legends|Teptixii system]]. However, the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] arrived and divided the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], which then fled.

Shortly after, twenty-eight Firekilns of Esva's [[Eastern Fleet]] [[Battle of the Poln system|fought]] Imperial forces&mdash;including the ''Admonitor'' and the ''Chimaera''&mdash;in the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector's]] [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]]. With the assistance of the Imperial [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], however, the Empire was able to destroy the Eastern Fleet.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Those are his ships, at any rate. Captain Parck would know better whether or not the warlord himself is on the scene. The point is that while the Firekilns are heavily armed, their shields are inferior to those of the Imperials. They rely on the screening ships to block the ''Admonitor''{{'s}} attacks.|Warlord Nuso Esva, under the pseudonym of Lord Odo|<ref name="Choices" />}}
Firekilns were a type of [[Warship/Legends|warship]] with shields inferior to those of an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]]. Armed with heavy [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]] that included [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], five Firekilns had firepower equal to that of an Imperial I. The [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were equipped with [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="Choices" />

==Role==
The Firekilns were used in ship-to-ship [[Space warfare/Legends|space warfare]].<ref name="Choices" />

==History==
===Battle at Teptixii===
{{Quote|Fortunately, I don't think Nuso Esva is interested in destroying cruisers today. The Firekilns could have done that long ago. I suspect he's hoping to disable or destroy the ''Admonitor'' and capture the smaller ships intact as additions to his fleet. If, on the other hand, we come around behind him as I suggested&hellip;''"<br />"''We'll force him to split his screening ships into two distinct and non-overlapping groups. Which I'm guessing he can't afford to do.|Warlord Nuso Esva, under the pseudonym of Lord Odo, and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]|<ref name="Choices" />}}
[[File:Thrawn_TFUCG.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Senior Captain Thrawn, whose forces fought Firekilns]]
The Firekilns were used by the<ref name="Choices" /> [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] within his [[Nuso Esva's realm|realm's]] [[Nuso Esva's battle fleet|battle fleet]]. Esva's [[Eastern Fleet]] included twenty-eight Firekilns. [[Nuso Esva's attack squadron|One]] of the warlord's attack [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] was formed by eight of the warships and twenty-seven [[Unidentified escort ship|escorts]].<ref name="Choices" />

As part of Esva's [[Nuso Esva's campaign against the Galactic Empire|campaign]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during his [[Nuso Esva–Empire of the Hand conflict|conflict]] with Imperial [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]<ref name="Choices" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> the warlord infiltrated the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']]. Having gained [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], Esva, who was under the pseudonym of [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]] member [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Odo, ordered the ''Chimaera'' to travel to the<ref name="Choices" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Teptixii system/Legends|Teptixii system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Teptixii system/Legends|Teptixii system]]</ref>

The ''Chimaera'' then arrived in the middle of a [[Engagement at Teptixii|battle]] between the Empire's [[Task Force Admonitor|Task Force ''Admonitor'']]&mdash;[[Flagship/Legends|led]] by the ''Imperial I''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]''&mdash;and Esva's attack squadron. The Firekilns, protected by their escorts, attempted to disable the ''Admonitor'' so that Esva's forces could capture the Imperial [[Task force/Legends|task force's]] two [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruisers]] and four [[Carrack-class light cruiser|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]] to add them to the Storm-hair warlord's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. Knowing his own forces' plans, Esva ordered [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Calo Drusan]] of the ''Chimaera'' to angle the ship thirty degrees to port and set its vector to divide the attack squadron by dividing its screening starships, which would allow the ''Admonitor''{{'s}} [[Laser/Legends|laserfire]] to reach the Firekilns and damage them significantly. The Firekilns and their escorts, unwilling to risk destruction, then jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="Choices" />

===A fiery collision===
{{Quote|The other ships of your task force are helpless to interfere. I have all of them trapped here by Poln Minor, and should any of them attempt to leave their current positions my Firekilns have been ordered to intercept and destroy. The only way to prevent the collision is for either the Chimaera or the Golan to open fire and destroy the other.''"<br />"''Twenty-eight Firekilns against two Star Destroyers. Are you so frightened of me, Nuso Esva?''"<br />"''I fear nothing. You may hide behind your Imperial underlings if you wish, aboard that freighter, and allow them to die before you. But you ''will'' die. And when you are dead, I will batter the worlds below you into rubble.|Warlord Nuso Esva and Senior Captain Thrawn|<ref name="Choices" />}}
[[File:SW_Executor_01.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Death Squadron (pictured) engaged Firekilns.]]
After Esva brought Task Force ''Admonitor'', Thrawn's [[DeepWater-class light freighter|''DeepWater''-class light freighter]] ''[[Lost Reef]]'', and the ''Chimaera'' to the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]], which was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]], the warlord's Eastern Fleet arrived. Trapping Task Force ''Admonitor'' with the [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] well of [[Poln Minor]], the second planet in the Poln [[Star system/Legends|system]], the warlord separated the two Imperial Star Destroyers from Candoras' [[Ferrouz's sector fleet|sector fleet]], preventing the fleet from assisting the warships. The Storm-hair also set the ''Chimaera''&mdash;whose [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] helm controls he sabotaged&mdash;on a collision course with a nearby [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan I]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] and ordered his twenty-eight Firekilns to [[Battle of the Poln system|destroy]] the Empire's forces if they moved to escape Poln Minor's gravity well and help the ''Chimaera''.<ref name="Choices" />

Revealing his true identity, Esva also told the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} senior captain that once he had destroyed the Chiss, the Firekilns would destroy Poln Major and Minor; however, the ''Lost Reef'' used its [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] to move the ''Chimaera'' away from its collision course. The Empire's [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] fleet, commanded by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], then arrived and destroyed the Eastern Fleet, and Esva fled aboard his [[Kazellis-class light freighter|''Kazellis''-class light freighter]] ''[[Salaban's Hope]]''.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Firekilns appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
